Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J40/J40nB479.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Zhufengxu of Zhaojue. Zhufeng Zhenxu owns the retained deployment: says at the incense of his abbacy that this stick of incense has stood frost and snow for over forty years and today the bag cannot hide it, so he serves it out on the whole tray, the first time he lifts it into the burner for his teacher of the Linji line, then with his hand forms the tray and tells all to look at what is served out whole, the light of wisdom too cold for a night sky, one bold step before the hall of the excellent, a lifetime never taken in.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J40/J40nB472.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Daboqian. Dabo Qian owns the retained deployment: asks how he could keep the sack shut with the assembled worthies come down to hear him, and serves out on the whole tray what Kasyapa smiled at and what Bodhidharma pointed straight, raising his whisk so that meeting it there opens the eye at the crown and lays bare the talisman behind the elbow, killing and living, seizing and loosing at every turn with no leak anywhere.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J27/J27nB193.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yinyuan. Yinyuan Longqi owns the retained deployment: at the Amitabha assembly he convenes verses the true man without rank and the dried shit-stick, the lotus-seat ancient buddha and the rotten winter melon, served out on the whole tray with no one who acknowledges them, looking back hesitant until the eyes double their flowers, then bundles the marks of the west and this soil into one ball and throws it before the assembly.

Shending Yikui owns the retained deployment: at the seat Yuanchen requests verses that the no-guest-no-host phrase sits by the fire, its pattern wholly shown with no word needed, the whole canon in five thousand scrolls no match for it, and that what was thought deep, hidden, and unreachable, once served out on the whole tray, shows everyone sitting by the rice basket starving to death, since rolling and furling free, the whole mind is buddha.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB185.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Fushi. Fushi Tongxian owns the retained deployment: pointing at the dharma seat of the Qizhen monastery verses that it stands sheer ten thousand fathoms, lonely and exposed in the open sun, served out on the whole tray with no one who meets it, so he climbs the curule seat again to raise it once more, then drinks and mounts the seat, spreading the incense.

Senses.Explanation: The whole tray served out at once, and the masters who hold nothing back, then ask what was served. Zhufeng Zhenxu says at the incense of his abbacy that this stick of incense has stood frost and snow for over forty years and today the bag cannot hide it, so he serves it out on the whole tray for the first time into the burner for his teacher, then forms the tray with his hand and tells all to look at what is served out whole, Dabo Qian asks how he could keep the sack shut with the assembled worthies come down, and serves out on the whole tray what Kasyapa smiled at and what Bodhidharma pointed straight, Yinyuan Longqi verses the true man without rank and the dried shit-stick, the lotus-seat ancient buddha and the rotten winter melon, served out on the whole tray with no one who acknowledges them, before bundling the far shore and this shore into one ball and throwing it before the assembly, and Baichi Xingyuan rules it a pity that Luoshan's good white rice was served out on the whole tray by Mingzhao as a private favor, labor without merit in the end, while at his Chaoguo there is white rice and moldy rice both but eating much is not allowed. Shending Yikui verses that the no-guest-no-host phrase sits by the fire with its pattern wholly shown and no word needed, the whole canon no match for it, and that what was thought deep, hidden, and unreachable, once served out on the whole tray, shows everyone sitting by the rice basket starving to death, Zhongfeng Mingben teaches that Yongjia, at the one grain of round light neither inside nor out with the myriad images mirrored in it, had already served it out on the whole tray, and that the vast mind-body leaves the marks of words, writing, holy and profane, and practice-verdict behind, Yulin Tongxiu teaches that every gate the buddhas and bodhisattvas have shown was walked to its end, and at the assembly of the nirvana sutra served out on the whole tray the true-suchness ocean and the flower-treasury gate, and Fushi Tongxian, pointing at the dharma seat, verses that it stands sheer ten thousand fathoms, lonely and exposed in the open sun, served out on the whole tray with no one who meets it, so he climbs the curule seat again to raise it once more.
